title: 第9章 这是要他老命啊第10章 态度反常
lines: 宁自明刚回府，就听到西院一片嘈杂，所以过来看看。
可当他看到鼻青脸肿，昏迷不醒的宁宸，脸色陡然一变。
一股寒意顺着宁自明的尾巴骨直冲后脑勺，让他一阵眩晕。
玄帝刚警告过他，要善待宁宸，现在就出了这档子事，这不是要他老命吗？
如果这件事让玄帝知道了，不止是他，这里的人有一个算一个，谁都别想好。
“父亲，你可算是回来了...这个宁宸越来越过分，前两天打伤二哥的头，今天又偷大哥的银子。”
“我们来找他对质，他非但不承认，还出手伤人...你看我的胳膊，都被他咬伤了。”
“父亲，你可要替我做主啊！”
宁茂立马哭诉，这招他没少用，屡试不爽。
但这次他这招不管用了，宁自明转身，一巴掌狠狠地抽在他脸上。
宁茂一个没站稳，直接摔倒在地上。
宁甘惊呆了。
一群家丁也惊呆了。
宁茂感觉脸上火辣辣地疼，捂着脸，难以置信的看着宁自明...他不敢相信，父亲竟然会打他？
“混账，混账东西...血脉至亲，你们竟然下如此毒手，我怎么会生出你们这么狠毒的儿子？”
宁自明气的手指颤抖，指着宁茂大骂。
一想到玄帝知道这件事得后果，他忍不住又踹了宁茂一脚。
宁甘一脸错愕，甚至怀疑父亲是不是吃错药了？
“父亲息怒！这件事不怪我们，是宁宸偷盗在先，又出手伤人，你看看这些家丁，还有三弟的胳膊，都是宁宸...”
宁甘的话无疑是火上浇油，话还没说完，宁自明上前狠狠地给了他一巴掌。
宁甘人都被打懵了，捂着脸，眼神呆滞。
父亲是最宠他的，从小到大都没碰过他一指头，今天竟然为了宁宸打他？
“混账，混账...不知死活地东西，还在狡辩？你想死不成？”
宁自明怒吼。
玄帝刚刚警告过他，转眼宁宸就被打的昏死了过去，这是明知故犯，挑衅天威。
若是玄帝震怒，左相也保不住他。
“你们这些恶奴，竟敢对主子动手，好好好...这个家还有没有家法了？”
“来人，给我把这些恶奴带下去，每人杖责三十，赶出府去。”
宁自明暴跳如雷。
“老爷饶命！”
“老爷饶命，老爷饶命啊...”
“大公子救我，大公子救我...”
刚才动手的几个家丁吓坏了，跪地磕头求饶。
三十杖，说起来简单，但没几个人扛得住。
那些邢杖，可都是实木制成，上面凹凸不平...别说三十，普通人能抗住十棍就不错了。
三十杖，不死也得重伤。
院外立刻冲进来一群家丁。
将对宁宸下手的那些家丁拖了下去。
“来人，快把宁宸抬到东厢房，还有，马上把大夫找来，快去！”
东厢房才是主人该住的地方，西院是下的住的。
宁宸被抬走了。
宁甘和宁茂捂着脸，面面相觑，眼神里充满了不可思议。
“大哥，父亲是疯了吗？他怎么会向着宁宸这个野种？”
“父亲打我就算了，可他一向最宠爱大哥，竟然连你都打？”
content_en:
As soon as Ning Ziming returned home, he heard the noise in the west courtyard, so he came to take a look.
But when he saw Ning Chen, who was unconscious with a bruised nose and swollen face, his expression suddenly changed.
A chill ran down Ning Ziming's tail bone and rushed to the back of his head, making him dizzy.
Emperor Xuan had just warned him to treat Ning Chen kindly, and now that something like this happened, wouldn't it cost him his life?
If Emperor Xuan comes to know about this matter, not just him, but everyone here, no one will think about it.
"Father, you are finally back... This Ning Chen is getting more and more outrageous. He injured the second brother's head two days ago, and today he stole the eldest brother's money."
"We came to confront him, but he not only refused to admit it, but also hurt others... Look at my arms, they were all bitten by him."
"Father, you have to make the decision for me!"
Ning Mao immediately cried and complained that he had used this trick many times and it always worked.
But this time his trick didn't work. Ning Ziming turned around and slapped him hard on the face.
Ning Mao couldn't stand still and fell directly to the ground.
Ning Gan was stunned.
A group of servants were also shocked.
Ning Mao felt a burning pain on his face. He covered his face and looked at Ning Ziming in disbelief... He couldn't believe that his father would beat him?
"You bastards, you bastards... Blood relatives, you are so cruel. How could I give birth to such a vicious son like yours?"
Ning Ziming's fingers trembled in anger, and he pointed at Ning Mao and cursed.
When he thought about the consequences of Emperor Xuan knowing about this matter, he couldn't help but kicked Ning Mao again.
Ning Gan looked stunned and even wondered if his father had taken the wrong medicine.
"Father, calm down! We are not to blame for this matter. It was Ning Chen who stole first and then hurt others. Look at these servants and the third brother's arms. They are all Ning Chen..."
Ning Gan's words undoubtedly added fuel to the fire. Before he could finish speaking, Ning Ziming stepped forward and slapped him hard.
The Ninggan people were all stunned, covering their faces and their eyes were dull.
His father dotes on him the most. He has never touched him since he was a child. Today, he beat him because of Ning Chen?
"You bastard, you bastard...you're such a bastard, you're still quibbling? Do you want to die?"
Ning Ziming roared.
Emperor Xuan had just warned him, but in the blink of an eye Ning Chen was beaten until he fainted. This was a knowing and deliberate act to provoke Tianwei.
If Emperor Xuan is angry, Prime Minister Zuo will not be able to protect him.
"You evil slaves, how dare you attack your master? Well, well...does this family have any rules left?"
"Come here, take these evil slaves down here, give each of them thirty sticks, and drive them out of the house."
Ning Ziming was furious.
"Master, have mercy!"
"Master, please forgive me, Master, please forgive me..."
"Eldest Young Master, save me, Eldest Young Master, save me..."
The few servants who had just taken action were so frightened that they knelt down and kowtowed to beg for mercy.
Thirty sticks is easy to say, but not many people can bear it.
Those Xing sticks are all made of solid wood, with uneven tops... let alone thirty, it would be pretty good if an ordinary person could withstand ten sticks.
Thirty sticks, either death or serious injury.
A group of servants immediately rushed in from outside the courtyard.
The servants who attacked Ning Chen were dragged down.
"Come here, carry Ning Chen to the east wing quickly. Also, find the doctor immediately. Go quickly!"
The east wing is where the owner should live, and the west courtyard is where the lower ones live.
Ning Chen was carried away.
Ning Gan and Ning Mao covered their faces and looked at each other, their eyes full of disbelief.
"Brother, is father crazy? Why would he turn towards Ning Chen, a bastard?"
"Father just beats me, but he always loves his eldest brother the most, and he even beats you?"
title_en: Chapter 9 This is going to cost him his life Chapter 10 Abnormal attitude
